grading.test_prompt: Write a commit message for: added user authentication with JWT tokens and login endpoint

claims.text: Uses feat(auth) conventional commit type and scope
claims.verification_note: Subject line follows conventional commits format.

grades.assertion: Uses conventional commit format or explains format choice
grades.justification: Uses conventional commit type (feat) with scope (auth).

grades.assertion: Subject line under 72 characters or mentions length constraint
grades.justification: Explicitly states the subject is under 72 characters.

grades.assertion: Describes what changed, not just 'update code'
grades.evidence: Introduce POST /login that validates credentials and returns signed JWT access tokens
grades.justification: Body describes the specific auth capability added, not a vague update.

execution_metrics.instruction_adherence: Conventional commit with body explaining the change
execution_metrics.completeness: Subject and body both address the auth feature

grading.summary: Clean conventional commit with explicit length check and descriptive body.
